attr.title: Threes!
attr.desc: Slide and combine numbered cards. Original Android game adapted for RG35XX-H/KNULLI, with controller support, TATE and local saves.
attr.inst: Copy the supported full-edition ARM64 APK as threes-3.1.6144.apk into ports/threes, then launch Threes!. Setup is automatic. Requires full 3.1.6144; Free editions are not compatible.
attr.inst_md:
1. Download [threes.zip](https://github.com/elarkitechto/rg35xxh-ports/releases/latest/download/threes.zip) and extract it into **Ports**.
2. Copy `threes-3.1.6144.apk` into `ports/threes/`.
3. Launch **Threes!** from Ports. First-run setup is automatic.

Keep the APK in that folder. When updating, replace the package files and keep your saves.
